findings.text: the done_when's population clause is measured nowhere; neither arm runs a test file importing reckon.crew.recovery_review_acceptance, so a regression in one of those 36 files would leave both logs green.

_record_inputs_moved wraps its write in suppress(OSError), so an unwritable run directory returns attempts=1 on every sweep and the retry never reaches INPUTS_MOVED_ATTEMPTS, turning the bounded retry into an unbounded one that still reports retry True.
the helper name _judge_moved_inputs_again differs from _judge_again_on_moved_inputs at :537 by word order alone, which is a reading hazard in a module whose two halves this change touches.

_inputs_moved_path adds a second durable per-run refusal-attempt counter rather than extending the one reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:697 _refusal_attempts already owns, so one run's attempt bookkeeping now lives in two stores under two policies.

_live_repair_attempt re-derives the open-repair predicate from REPAIR_DISPATCH_FIELD and REPAIR_ROUND_OPENING_STATUSES instead of extending reckon/crew/obligations.py:1891 _repair_round_in_flight, so the two predicates can drift over which statuses count as open without a test noticing.

assert seen["moves"] == 1 compares the test's own counter, incremented by the test's own hook of the pointer move, against the limit the test configured, so it is a harness sanity check rather than a guard on the retry.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names four behavioural cases plus a population clause; tests/test_a_promotion_refused_for_moved_inputs_is_judged_again.py carries one test per behavioural case and the manifest records 4 failed at base 18d133b40e and 4 passed at head, but the clause that the tests importing reckon.crew.recovery_review_acceptance add no failure against the base is run by neither arm.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to judge a promotion refused for moved inputs again on the next sweep; reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:537 returns retry True with the attempts spent and the fields that moved, and :1398 re-queues the run through request_promotion(retry=True).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits a7d9a37e0b 997e33ceb3 da06624803, baseline_suite 58 passed EXIT=0 at 18d133b40e, after_suite 62 passed EXIT=0 at 997e33ceb3, negative-control 1 failed EXIT=1, and the two superseded base attempts attributed to scaffolding with their cause.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py, tests/test_a_promotion_refused_for_moved_inputs_is_judged_again.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-tells-the-truth-under-load/moved-inputs-promotion-retried-s16.html; the diff 18d133b40e..da06624803 changes exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation standing down reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:1398 reddens tests/test_a_promotion_refused_for_moved_inputs_is_judged_again.py:158-168 at negative-control.log EXIT=1, while the harness counter assertion at :149 cannot fail while the gate hook is reached at all.
justifications.evidence: baseline_suite and after_suite are recorded results (58 passed EXIT=0 at 18d133b40e, 62 passed EXIT=0 at 997e33ceb3) but neither arm runs any test file importing reckon.crew.recovery_review_acceptance, and the base arm runs tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py instead.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:537 (_judge_again_on_moved_inputs) and :1398 (_judge_moved_inputs_again) differ by word order only, so a reader scanning the module cannot tell the judgement-side outcome from the sweep-side re-queue.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:1398-1437 re-queues an acceptance refusal whose result carries retry, so the next judgement reads the inputs the run now has instead of ending on a state that no longer exists.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:482 adds a second durable per-run repeated-refusal counter beside reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:697 _refusal_attempts and _record_attempt, and :1362 re-reads REPAIR_DISPATCH_FIELD rather than extending reckon/crew/obligations.py:1891 _repair_round_in_flight.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 18d133b40e..da06624803 touches only the three declared write paths, including the evidence fragment the node was fenced to.
